decisions.reason: Carrier wafers for small-diameter handling use existing polishing and drilling capabilities at low incremental cost and match the stated direction toward reusable carriers and thin-wafer handling.
The Cu-interposer glass wafer is a flagship technology launched at SEMICON and fits strong demand for advanced packaging and interposers, so the firm would keep developing it.
The Wafer Universe off-the-shelf brand is close to the core business, adds a low-cost sales channel for standard glass and quartz wafers, and is presented as a focus of the firm's direction.

Glass-based circuit boards are distant from the core offer and riskier, but they share glass structuring and metallization know-how with the interposer line and benefit from growing interest in glass substrates, so the firm keeps them for now.
